'''Antonio Turiel Martínez'''  (born in [[Province of León|León]], 1970) is a scientist and teacher of Physics and Math. He has a doctorate in Theoretical Physics from the [[Autonomous University of Madrid|Universidad Autónoma de Madrid]]. He works with the [[Instituto de Ciencias del Mar]] at [[Spanish National Research Council|CSIC]], located in [[Barcelona]].<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Antonio Turiel - Citations Google Scholar |url=https://scholar.google.fr/citations?user=XGfURmwAAAAJ&hl=fr&cstart=0&pagesize=20 |access-date=25 January 2016 |website=scholar.google.fr}}</ref><ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Antonio Turiel |url=http://www.eldiario.es/autores/antonio_turiel/ |access-date=25 January 2016 |website=eldiario.es}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |last=Picazo |first=Sergi |date=2022-03-22 |title=Antonio Turiel: "No es verdad que no se pueda hacer nada para parar el colapso" - Climática |url=https://www.climatica.lamarea.com/entrevista-antonio-turiel-critic/ |access-date=2022-04-18 |language=es}}</ref>

== Career ==
Turiel is known for his work of a science communicator, scientific publications and presentations, and his blog ''The Oil Crash.'' The blog explores themes of [[resource depletion]], especially around fossil fuels, and he was an early advocate for examining the impacts of [[Peak oil]] on society, and on both a global scale and in Spanish speaking economies.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Entrevista a Antonio Turiel |url=http://www.fuhem.es/ecosocial/noticias.aspx?v=9268 |access-date=25 January 2016}}</ref><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=Puente |first=Arturo |date=2022-04-12 |title=Antonio Turiel, el científico que lleva una década predicando en el desierto sobre el fin de las materias primas |url=https://www.eldiario.es/catalunya/antonio-turiel-cientifico-lleva-decada-predicando-desierto-materias-primas_1_8900735.html |access-date=2022-04-18 |website=ElDiario.es |language=es}}</ref>

Turiel argues for [[degrowth]] arguing for the "reduction of the metabolism of Society" and considers this inevitable. He is critical of the role of the [[Productivism]] in both leftist and right wing politics.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=Lo que no Podemos |url=http://www.eldiario.es/ultima-llamada/Podemos_6_313278693.html |access-date=25 January 2016 |website=eldiario.es}}</ref><ref name=":6">{{Cite web |last=Capital |first=Redacción |date=2022-02-09 |title=CSIC: Nos dirigimos a una gran crisis económica - Capital 2022 |url=https://capital.es/2022/02/09/csic-crisis-economica-energia-turiel/ |access-date=2022-04-18 |language=es}}</ref>  He argued that its impossible to maintain a capitalist economy and facilitate an [[Energy transition]] because of the inherient limitations of renewable energy<ref>{{Cite web |title="Antonio Turiel: “Reducir el consumo energético es reformular el sistema capitalista, pero eso es un tabú”" |url=https://as.com/actualidad/ciencia/antonio-turiel-reducir-el-consumo-energetico-es-reformular-el-sistema-capitalista-pero-eso-es-un-tabu-n/}}</ref><ref name=":6" /> Turiel argues that the "idea of infinite growth" would lead to the collapse of humanity in the 21st century.<ref name=":4"/>

In the context of political economy, Turiel argues that the energy transition is difficult considering the current way of life, and such a transition implies a substantial decrease in material intensity and primary energy, which is politically unpopular.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |last=Pont |first=Aleix Camprubí i |date=2022-03-03 |title=Antonio Turiel: "Rússia fora del mercat seria el col·lapse absolut" |url=https://www.rtve.es/television/20220303/gemma-nierga-entrevista-antonio-turiel/2301233.shtml |access-date=2022-03-06 |website=RTVE.es |language=ca}}</ref>

About renewable energy, Turiel reflects that the limits of production and the likelihood that a fossil fuel crises will create a material shortage, necessarily limiting the production of renewables.<ref name=":5"/><ref name=":7">{{Cite web |title=cuellilargo. - REPOST: Entrevista a Antonio Turiel - Apagones eléctricos, peak oil y petrocalipsis {{!}} Facebook {{!}} By cuellilargo. {{!}} Repost: Entrevista a Antonio Turiel sobre apagones eléctricos, peak oil y petrocalipsis. Esperamos que nos sirva para construir el colapso que queremos. |url=https://www.facebook.com/cuellilargo/videos/entrevista-a-antonio-turiel-apagones-el%C3%A9ctricos-peak-oil-y-petrocalipsis/302472271504932/ |access-date=2022-07-10 |website=www.facebook.com |language=es}}</ref>

He has testified in front of several governments: to the Energy Commission of the Basque Parlement on 29 September 2018,<ref>{{Cite web |title=El fin del capitalismo no es el fin del mundo |url=https://www.eldiario.es/euskadi/euskadi/fin-capitalismo-mundo_1_4626336.html |access-date=10 April 2021 |website=eldiario.es}}</ref>  the Quinta Commission of the Colombian Congress over banning fracking on 12 February 2021 {{Citation needed|date=July 2025}} and the Commission for the Energy Transition in the Spanish Senate on 12 April 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Comparecencia del Doctor en Física Teórica, D. Antonio Turiel Martínez, ante la Comisión de Transición Ecológica, para informar en relación con la materia objeto de estudio de la Ponencia sobre los retos de una transición energética sostenible, constituida en el seno de la Comisión.  XIV Legislatura |url=https://www.senado.es/web/actividadparlamentaria/iniciativas/detalleiniciativa/index.html?legis=14&id1=715&id2=000346 |access-date=10 April 2021 |website=senado.es}}</ref>

Turiel interpreted the [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|Invasion of Ukraine in February 2022]] as a responded to energy and mineral problems by Russia, and the difficulty of the energy transition in that contest.<ref name=":3"/>

== Publications ==

=== Books ===
* 2013 — ''Un futuro sin más'', Antonio Turiel, Kindle Edition. Novela de ficción especulativa.
* 2020 — ''Petrocalipsis'', Antonio Turiel, 2020, Editorial Alfabeto, {{ISBN|978-84-17951-10-8}}. Ensayo divulgativo sobre la crisis energética.
* 2022 — ''El otoño de la civilización'', [[Juan Bordera]] y Antonio Turiel (Prólogo de [[Yayo Herrero]]. Epílogo de Jorge Riechmann), Editorial Escritos Contextatarios, {{ISBN|978-84-09-38126-5}}.
* 2022 — ''Sin energía'', Antonio Turiel, 2022, Editorial Alfabeto, {{ISBN|978-84-17951-32-0}}.
* 2024 — ''El futuro de Europa. Cómo decrecer para una reindustrialización urgente'', Antonio Turiel, 2024, Ediciones Destino, {{ISBN|978-84-233-6641-5}}.
